title: Детектирование и построение состязательных примеров, поиск аномалий во входных данных и экспертная оценка модели
summary: A research codebase for detecting adversarial examples, anomalies, and expert-evaluating trusted/explainable-AI models on omics data (DNA methylation for Parkinson's classification and immunological age regression). Its adversarial.py modules use SDV's SingleTablePreset, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and CopulaGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic data for augmentation and evaluate them with evaluate_quality.
evidence: src/tasks/classification/adversarial.py:334-339 builds synthesizers dict with SingleTablePreset, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, fit and sampled for augmentation
